entities.summary: Zaima Zarnaz Rahman, better known as Zaima Rahman, is a barrister and the only daughter of Tarique Rahman, the Prime minister of Bangladesh. She is the granddaughter of former Bangladeshi Prime Minister Khaleda Zia and former President Ziaur Rahman.
